description: Returns unit traits (native or set by [[setUnitTrait]]).
examples:
<sqf>
private _playerTraits = getAllUnitTraits player;
/*
Could return something like this:
[
	["Medic", false],
	["Engineer", false],
	["ExplosiveSpecialist", false],
	["UavHacker", false],
	["CamouflageCoef", 1],
	["AudibleCoef", 1],
	["LoadCoef", 1],
	["test", "custom"]
]
*/
</sqf>

<sqf>
private _unitTraits = getAllUnitTraits _unit;
private _indexes = [_unitTraits, "Medic"] call BIS_fnc_findNestedElement;
private _unitCanHeal = _unitTraits select (_indexes select 0) select 1;
</sqf>

Since {{GVI|arma3|2.18|size= 0.75}}:
<sqf>
hint str getAllUnitTraits "O_Engineer_F";
/*
[
	["Medic", false],
	["Engineer", true],
	["ExplosiveSpecialist", true],
	["UavHacker", false],
	["CamouflageCoef", 1],
	["AudibleCoef", 1],
	["LoadCoef", 1]
]
*/
</sqf>
name: getAllUnitTraits

Item.desc: a unit or a class name
Item.name: unit
